sous_titre: Variation de l indice mondial depuis le début de l année, en pourcentage, renouvellements de 2025 et 2026

1er janvier 2025.texte: This Index had fallen by 6.6% at January 1st 2025 and by 8.1% after the mid-year 2025

Mi-2025.texte: after including market data from the mid-year renewals, this Global index is now down 8.1% for 2025 to-date.

1er janvier 2026.texte: Guy Carpenter's Global Property Catastrophe Rate-On-Line Index fell by 12% at January 1st 2026

Mi-2026.texte: property catastrophe rate on line (ROL) remains down globally, around 16%
